book.name: Hibulu
book.title: Yu so dla yu ilimale hamili Hibulu

content: God Yamitapo banakaka sota itiyamaleye tla꞉mtame halapo
Mo-powataliya Godtapo ya꞉ yu molo atlamalalo so tle di mamadulo dla api meyelope meyelope dle tle molo atlamhalemduwapo.

Amasiyama wata mosukulu alila oloma hema ya꞉tapo ya꞉ yuye Yami tle dia꞉ dla yukamuwapo. Epedeme ya꞉tapo Yami tle alisisi hapulomaye mimita꞉pame Yamiye mo-sauwapo, ya꞉tapo alotle alisisi hapulomaye omhallepo depame.

Epedeme Yamitapo Godta hela꞉dle hamhalemama God mila꞉pi ikadepe himhalapo. Epame ya꞉tapo ya꞉ yu itiyamale tle koko hapulomaye halopo hallalo halapo. Epedeme ya꞉tapo opa yia꞉ bobtalimaleye howahalopo gudepame Pepele dimo dla hetame pato God dowala tiyama dla polapo.
Epapele dulu dla Yamitapo banakaka soye tla꞉mtame halapo. Epame Godtapo Yami watle hi hamiwatapo banakaka so dla hi halopiliye tla꞉mtame halapo.
Ame adipalati, Godta ya꞉ banakaka oplami hale dla yu po-ipo atlana,

content.text: “Wa꞉ye na꞉ Maseyemalapo,
watapo na꞉ye wa꞉ A dlepo,” pe-epo atlana.

content: Epame Godtapo banakaka so hale dla ma yu hale po-ipo atlana,

content.text: “Na꞉tapo ya꞉ A dlepe,
epalati ya꞉tapo na꞉ Maseyemala dlepe,” pe-epo atlana.

content: Epame matle Godtapo Yami hatloye ta꞉lamo dla seme maluwa oloma edla, ya꞉tapo epo atluwapo,

content.text: “God ya꞉ banakaka so hapulomatapo hatlo Yami dla heodepame siyele hamilipe,” duwapo.

content: Amasiyama Godtapo ya꞉ banakaka so koko dla yu ipo atluwapo,

content.text: “Godtapo ya꞉ banakaka soye ya꞉ oko so depame mosisi some hallepo depame mimita꞉puwapo.
Epame dlapa teleka꞉le some hallepo depame mimita꞉puwapo.”

content: Amasiyama ya꞉tapo ya꞉ Maseyemala koko dla epo atluwapo,

content.text: “God, wa꞉ mo kokotapo kokó elepo ellepe.
Epame wa꞉tapo ka꞉dle api tle wa꞉ opaye woloma omhallepe.
Epame wa꞉ ka꞉dle koko tlo solotamama
asiyama batalimale koko tlo alimhalemduwapo.
Epapele koko tle wa꞉ Godtapo wa꞉ye ma-sepame
wa꞉ dla siyele hamiwapo.
Siyele wa꞉ dla hamiwa etapo wa꞉ amkadulo dla siyele hutiyeye tla꞉mtame halapo.”
“Lod, wa꞉tapo kotiyamale sitali dla ta꞉lamoye wa꞉ta mita꞉puwapo.
Epame pepele di ma wa꞉ dota mimita꞉puwapo.
Epapele tlope ta꞉lamo mate epo pepele di mate pa꞉lepe.
Yia꞉tapo tluka takala some sosola꞉timelepe.
Amasiyama Lod, wa꞉ye kokó halepo hallepe.
Epame Lod, wa꞉tapo ta꞉lamo mate pepele di mate tluka takala some popolopo hamastlepe.
Epalati yia꞉tapo ma mila꞉pi meyelope dlepe.
Amasiyama Lod, wa꞉ye pomeyelope desemde.
Epame wa꞉ye sukulu pa꞉le hallalopo.”

content: Epapele dulu dla Godtapo banakaka oplami hale dla yu po-ipo atlana,

content.text: “Wa꞉ na꞉ dowala tiyama dla polane.
Wa꞉ pollati na꞉tapo wa꞉ watle opahale demha꞉ha꞉ soye wa꞉ hete sitali isili dla hatitimolowepo,” pe-epo atlana.

content: Amasiyama banakaka so hapulomaye isikimi God yu dla salladepo siyamalalo sokopo. Yia꞉ye Godtapo taiya duwapo, yia꞉tapo pasakalo gadle halowedeme ha꞉ha꞉ soye gadlepo depame.
